title: AI-generated code with hallucinated CVSS reference
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin ai-fingerprint observed rules
description:
Detects source-code comments or docstrings that cite a CVSS score / CVE identifier in a free-text context typical of LLM output (no surrounding security review or threat-model framing). Hallucinated CVSS references are a known signature of LLM-generated security tooling.

Aggregated from 1 fingerprint hit(s) across 1 file(s). Sample paths: apps/foo/bar.py.
